cases.name: retained-parent-plus-capture
cases.assert: parent output and live capture do not each get a fresh allowance

cases.name: nested-live-copy-memory
cases.assert: preflight real parent/child snapshots before allocating

cases.name: ancestor-input-write-guard
cases.source: while read -r line; do value=$(printf changed > source.txt); done < source.txt
cases.assert: child does not escape ancestor guard

cases.name: compile-before-first-side-effect
cases.assert: keep.txt remains retained because root compile fails before execution

cases.name: unsupported-child-not-masked
cases.assert: outer status cannot turn unsupported behavior into accepted work

cases.name: capture-data-not-source
cases.expected: ordinary literal output; no output re-lexing

cases.name: explicitly-deferred-arithmetic-position
cases.assert: if first-slice arithmetic exclusion is chosen

cases.name: aggregate-call-ceiling-parent-plus-child
cases.source: recur() { printf "%s" x; recur; }; outer() { value=$(recur); }; outer
cases.assert: one active parent call plus31 child-entered calls reaches32; another call must fail; no fresh child allowance

cases.name: exclude-direct-local-inherited-parent-function
cases.source: outer() { local label=outer; value=$(local label=inner; printf "%s" "$label"); }; outer
cases.assert: direct capture-top-level local is excluded even though real Bash permits inherited parent context

cases.name: exclude-direct-return-inherited-parent-function
cases.assert: direct capture-top-level return cannot unwind parent and must fail honestly under selected scope
